title: Talent Poaching and Job Rotation
eligible_reason: Single policy date and continuous exposure: the DiD (Table 5, Figure 3) interacts a post-policy indicator (month2 > 26, the anti-poaching policy change) with the worker's predicted poaching probability (ProbRF_SD, continuous from a random forest; HighRisk/HighProbHS splits in appendix), with time-varying controls (LogNWDayspm, LogExp_f) and worker, month, first-month and building-month FE, some with worker trends. The appendix did_imputation sets Ei = 136 for all high-probability workers (one cohort). Tables 2-4 regress productivity on continuous client-specific experience. No staggered binary treatment; shipped data are a mock-up.
design_notes: Package: code/0_master.do, 1_cleandata.do, 2_table1-5.do, 2_figure1-3.do, 3_appendix.do, programs.do, RF.py/RF_BS.py; processed/MOCKUP_DATASET_REGRESSIONS.dta (code expects DATASET_REGRESSIONS.dta; the shipped file is explicitly a mock-up); input/ spreadsheets (IPC, UPZ, firm size survey); log/log.txt from the authors' run; MainTablesFigures.tex and Appendix.tex. Stata packages: reghdfe, did_imputation, event_plot, ppmlhdfe, ivreghdfe.
screener_notes: Personnel data from a security-service firm; the README-equivalent (master do-file header and file name) indicates the regression dataset is a mock-up.
